Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the business and occupation taxation of newspaper-labeled supplements.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the business and occupation taxation ofnewspaperlabeled supplements; and amending RCW 82.04.214.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.04.214 and 1994 c 22 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Newspaper" means a publication issued regularly at statedintervals at least twice a month and printed on newsprint in tabloid orbroadsheet format folded loosely together without stapling, glue, orany other binding of any kind, or means any newspaperlabeledsupplement produced in any media.
